mass.definition: Present-day cluster mass inferred from present-day mass-function analysis; not a sum of repository stars or an initial mass.
mass.title: Diagnosing Open Cluster Stock 2: Member Candidates and Mass Distribution with Gaia DR2 and LAMOST
mass.uncertainty_status: No formal mass uncertainty supplied in the adopted provenance; none inferred.
mass.provenance_status: Adopted from user-specified literature result; primary full text could not be retrieved in this session. Detailed mass-function corrections and tidal-radius derivation not independently audited.
mass.comparison_role: 22.65 pc is comparison only, never a Jacobi input; same-paper quantities need not be statistically independent.

model.name: galpy MWPotential2014
model.potential_convention: Phi is potential per unit test mass; acceleration=-grad(Phi).
model.omega_definition: Circular equilibrium frequency sqrt(-F_R(R,0)/R), NOT the actual orbit angular rate v_phi/R.
model.approximation: Local circular-equivalent midplane Jacobi scale at instantaneous cylindrical R. Not an exact Jacobi boundary on an eccentric, vertically oscillating orbit.
model.vertical_treatment: Actual R,z forces and Phi_RR are auxiliary diagnostics. Jacobi denominator always uses z=0. Stored orbit z is not inserted into midplane frequency identities.
model.mass_evolution: 4000 solMass held fixed throughout the stored orbit; no mass loss.

integration_inherited.initialization: independent past and future integrations each start from supplied t=0 state
integration_inherited.internal_step: adaptive; output cadence is not internal solver step

frame_inherited.assumption: Adopted Galactic modelling assumptions, not measured properties of Stock 2.
frame_inherited.convention: Astropy v4.0 parameter set, explicitly frozen for Project 04A

galcen_coord.meaning: Adopted ICRS direction of Galactic centre

galcen_distance.meaning: Distance from the solar-system origin to the Galactic centre, including solar height

galcen_v_sun.meaning: Solar velocity relative to Galactic centre, in adopted Cartesian X,Y,Z axes; includes total azimuthal motion

roll.meaning: Additional roll relative to Astropy's Galactic-plane orientation

z_sun.meaning: Height of the solar-system origin above the adopted Galactic midplane

secondary_literature: Later Stock 2 studies/catalogues may use different tidal-radius definitions. No later numeric radius is adopted; none was independently verified for this project.
